name: Seiheki Sousa ~Konna Koto, Daikkirai na Hazu na no ni...!~
original_name: 性癖操作～こんなコト、大ッ嫌いなはずなのに…！～
source:
The protagonist worked in a hospital and came into possession of a revolutionary forbidden drug called Drop. With it he immediately abused his beautiful female staff - well-meaning doctor Sanae and man-hating nurse Rin, both sisters. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE068598.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角在一家医院工作，并拥有一种名为Drop的革命禁药。他用它立即虐待了他美丽的女员工——善意的医生早苗和讨厌男人的护士凛，她们都是姐妹。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE068598.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
